Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an incorrect normalization rule that mapped any “Palos Verdes” mention (including “Palos Verdes Estates”) to “Rancho Palos Verdes, CA.” This conflated distinct cities on the Palos Verdes Peninsula and would override credible obituary sources that specifically state “Palos Verdes Estates,” leading to an incorrect final death location.
